title: LandlordGuard Earned Premium Table for Named-Insured Cancellations
content:
When the named insured cancels a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy midterm, the tier decides the unearned premium basis, the share the carrier keeps under a short-rate basis, and the minimum earned premium.

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unearned premium basis on a named-insured cancellation | short rate | short rate | pro rata | pro rata | pro rata | pro rata |
| Share of the pro-rata unearned premium kept on a short-rate cancellation (percent) | 10 | 10 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Premium kept at minimum on a named-insured midterm cancellation (USD) | 100.00 | 100.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 |

## Notes

- LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic and DP-2 Broad cancel on a short-rate basis, keeping 10 percent of the pro-rata unearned premium; the DP-3 tiers use a pro-rata basis and keep nothing of it.
- The minimum earned premium is 100.00 USD on DP-1 Basic and DP-2 Broad, 75.00 USD on DP-3 Special and DP-3 Special Plus, and 50.00 USD on DP-3 Premier and DP-3 Portfolio.

## Hypothetical illustration

With a hypothetical pro-rata unearned premium of 400.00 USD, a LandlordGuard DP-2 Broad policy keeps 10 percent of it, 40.00 USD, leaving 360.00 USD returnable; a LandlordGuard DP-3 Special policy keeps 0 percent and leaves the full 400.00 USD returnable.
